heading: Behaviour Is Never “Just Bad Behaviour”
blockquote: What a dog does is often their way of telling us how they feel.
body:
Many unwanted behaviours are rooted in fear, anxiety, uncertainty, frustration or previous experiences. Simply correcting what we can see rarely addresses the reason behind it.

Instead, we look at the individual dog: their body language, triggers, environment, history and emotional response. This helps us understand what the behaviour is communicating before creating a realistic plan to support change.

Every dog is different, so every approach must be different too. The aim is not to force a dog to comply, but to help them feel safer, more understood and more able to cope.
